items.title: Show HN: Cafca – a synthetic face dataset with 1.75M images
items.contentSnippet:
Hi all, as part of my PhD, I released the world’s largest public dataset of synthetic faces "Cafca".
I used it to train a foundation model for 3D face reconstruction and novel view synthesis. It is also meant to serve as a prior for animatable avatars, semantic segmentation, and relighting. Here is what it contains:
# Images: 1.755 M (512x512)
# Identities: 1,500
# Expressions: 13
# Environments: 3
# Views: 30

items.title: Show HN: FAB – A benchmark for AI agents doing financial due diligence
items.contentSnippet:
The world economy around us depends on complex financial work. How well can AI do it?
We(a team of ex-EY employees) built FAB - Finance Agents Benchmark, testing AI Agents on the work behind financial due diligence.
Agents can find the relevant facts, but still struggle to carry them through to a complete, reliable analysis.
We’ll keep expanding FAB to more companies and testing more models. Building and running this benchmark isn’t cheap, so we’re scaling it in stages.
The benchmark is public.
